body.en:
Question B-002-008-011.

Why the correct answer is right: If you cannot help directly, contact authorities and keep watch in case you can relay or provide further information.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "enter the details in the logbook and take no further action": Logging and then doing nothing abandons a situation where you may still be useful.
- sourceIndex 2: "take no action": Taking no action ignores the responsibility to pass the distress information to someone who can help.
- sourceIndex 3: "tell all other stations to cease transmitting": Ordering all stations off the air may exceed your role and could silence stations that can provide assistance.
